calls.reason: Stack Overflow moderators reported frequent incorrect programming answers in December 2022. That supports recurring errors, but does not distinguish fabrication or establish its frequency across ChatGPT output generally.

The user study found 89.64% intent-category accuracy for GPT-4 Turbo. It does not establish whether those results suffice for practical assistant actions or whether clarification resolves remaining errors.

DecodingTrust reported previously unpublished GPT-4 bias vulnerabilities in June 2023, about three months after release. The limited findings under benign prompts do not negate the discovery of examples.

AI Impacts documents substantial ChatGPT attention, while OpenAI confirms GPT-4's release within ChatGPT. Neither compares attention across the launches; the attention prediction is also phrased as a safe bet.
The scaling studies show useful gains and saturation under specific constraints. They do not establish whether scaling alone ultimately falls short of trustworthy general intelligence.
The 2026 International AI Safety Report documents reliability limitations. The packet identifies no demonstrated trustworthy, aligned AGI whose architecture could settle the prediction.
